input.subject: New job: sticking front door – Flat 16, 76 Alder Lane, Kingshaven, ZZ8 8ZZ (Ref R/PM015-1)
input.body:
Hi Imogen,

The landlord has asked for you to attend the following job:

Property: Flat 16, 76 Alder Lane, Kingshaven, ZZ8 8ZZ
Reference: R/PM015-1
Issue: The front door is sticking and difficult to open and close. The tenant reports it catches at the base; they have checked and there is no obstruction underneath. Possible causes include hinge movement, misalignment or swelling.

Please inspect and advise on the fix. If the repair needs anything beyond a straightforward adjustment, please send us your findings and a cost before going ahead so we can confirm with the landlord.

Please contact the tenant to arrange a convenient time to visit. We haven't got their availability yet, so please arrange it with them directly and let us know the date once it's agreed.

Many thanks,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

Hi Freya,

Thank you for your patience. The landlord has asked us to send a contractor, Imogen, to inspect the sticking front door at Flat 16, 76 Alder Lane, Kingshaven, ZZ8 8ZZ (ref R/PM015-1).

Imogen will be in touch to arrange a time to visit. If you'd like to share your usual availability with us, we'll pass it on.

In the meantime, if the door won't close or lock securely, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
